description: One cost line item (one row of ``cost_db.csv``). Team data, not course data.

cluster.description: Course cluster letter or name (A-H, e.g. 'Shell') or a custom cluster from tvd.custom_clusters.
cluster.title: Cluster

assembly_code.description: Uniformat code (engines/common/uniformat.csv, level 3, or the 4-digit form of a level-2 code such as B2000), or a sub-code 'B2010.CW'.
assembly_code.title: Assembly Code

description.description: Line item description; required unless the row is a placeholder (unit, unit_cost and description all empty).
description.title: Description

unit.description: Unit: SF, GSF, MSF, LF, EA, FLIGHT, CY, CF, SY, STORY, LS, TON, LB, GAL, HR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, %.
unit.title: Unit

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit (plain decimal); empty = unpriced.
unit_cost.title: Unit Cost

quantity_rule.description: takeoff | fixed | per_gsf | pct_of_subtotal | mirror:<AC> | count_codes:<AC,...>
quantity_rule.title: Quantity Rule

quantity_value.description: fixed: the quantity; per_gsf: factor per GSF (empty = 1); pct_of_subtotal: percent (0-100]; empty for the other rules.
quantity_value.title: Quantity Value

qty_reliability.description: Quantity reliability 1 = high, 2 = medium, 3 = low (course scale); empty = not rated.
qty_reliability.title: Qty Reliability

cost_reliability.description: Unit cost reliability 1 = high, 2 = medium, 3 = low (course scale); empty = not rated.
cost_reliability.title: Cost Reliability

source.description: Where the unit cost comes from (free text).
source.title: Source

split_keywords.description: Sub-code rows only: keywords ('|'-separated) that route takeoff elements of the base code to this sub-code, or '*' for the rest.
split_keywords.title: Split Keywords

qty_label.description: Optional label for the quantity source (qty_src); empty = the engine's generic label.
qty_label.title: Qty Label

title: cost_db.csv row
x-csv-notes: One CSV row per line item. Empty cells = null / empty string. Numbers are plain decimals (pattern ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$). Lines starting with '#' are comments. See docs/engines/tvd.md.
